Discovered from 8408-54bb (Gerrit change 2071 PS2 LLM-Review advisory, correctness, src/rebar/_errors.py:108).

## Context / Problem

error_code_for step 4 classifies EVERY ConfigError subclass as `config_unreadable` by isinstance, including InsecureUrlError (src/rebar/_config_schema.py) — which was explicitly designed to let a caller tell a deliberate cleartext-URL security-policy rejection apart from a malformed-config parse fault (bug bdb8). An MCP client branching on `config_unreadable` would mis-prompt the operator to 'fix an unreadable config' when the config parsed fine and was rejected by policy.

## Plan

Operator confirmed the code name: `config_insecure_url`.

1. src/rebar/_errors.py: add `config_insecure_url` to KNOWN_ERROR_CODES; in error_code_for step 4, classify InsecureUrlError (lazy import from rebar._config_schema) BEFORE the ConfigError arm so it returns `config_insecure_url`; plain ConfigError keeps returning `config_unreadable`. Update the docstring precedence list.
2. scripts/gen_mcp_reference.py: extend the failure-shape paragraph to document the distinct `config_insecure_url` code; regenerate docs/mcp-reference.md (generated file — CI drift gate).
3. RED-first unit test tests/unit/test_error_code_insecure_url_7d6a.py: InsecureUrlError -> `config_insecure_url`; code is in KNOWN_ERROR_CODES; plain ConfigError still -> `config_unreadable`; classification is message-independent.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] `rebar.error_code_for(InsecureUrlError(...))` returns `config_insecure_url`, verified by `python -m pytest tests/unit/test_error_code_insecure_url_7d6a.py -q` (written RED first, passing after the fix)
- [ ] `config_insecure_url` is a member of `rebar.KNOWN_ERROR_CODES`, asserted in the same test module
- [ ] A plain `ConfigError` still classifies as `config_unreadable`, verified by `python -m pytest tests/unit/test_mcp_gate_unreadable_config_errors_8408.py -q`
- [ ] docs/mcp-reference.md regenerated in parity via `python scripts/gen_mcp_reference.py` (drift gate passes with `--check`)
- [ ] `make lint`, `make typecheck`, and `python scripts/check_complexity_baseline.py --check` all pass

## Testing

Targeted: `python -m pytest tests/unit/test_error_code_insecure_url_7d6a.py tests/unit/test_mcp_gate_unreadable_config_errors_8408.py tests/interfaces/contracts/test_mcp_error_envelope_happy.py tests/interfaces/contracts/test_mcp_error_envelope_heldout.py -q`. Gates: `make lint`, `make typecheck`, `python scripts/check_complexity_baseline.py --check`, `python scripts/gen_mcp_reference.py --check`.
